title: U̠t-Ma'in language
description: Northwest Kainji dialect continuum of Nigeria
extract:
u̠t-Ma'in or Fakai is a Northwest Kainji dialect continuum spoken by 36,000 people in Nigeria. There are numerous rather divergent dialects:Kag 
Jiir 
Kur 
Zuksun 
Ror 
Fer 
Us (Et-Us)
Koor (Kulu)
extract_html:
u̠t-Ma'in or Fakai is a Northwest Kainji dialect continuum spoken by 36,000 people in Nigeria. There are numerous rather divergent dialects:

  • Kag
  • Jiir
  • Kur
  • Zuksun
  • Ror
  • Fer
  • Us (Et-Us)
  • Koor (Kulu)
